prompt: The last status update today confirms that P8-M is still the registered destination. Which update should the morning planner receive?
promptZh: 今天最後一次狀態更新確認，P8-M 仍是登記的匯出目的地。應給早班排程人員什麼訊息？
evidence: Only one calendar per press may receive the export. / Calendar P8-M: registered export destination; Tuesday time rows duplicated; annotations readable. / Tonight’s export will contain corrected Tuesday time rows. / If that confirmation does not arrive today, leave both calendar names unchanged and tell the morning planner where tonight’s time rows will land.

options.text: The corrected rows will appear in both calendars.
options.zh: 兩份行事曆都會收到已修正的資料列。
options.why: Only one calendar is allowed to receive the export.
options.whyZh: 每台沖床只能有一份行事曆接收匯出。

options.text: The corrected rows will appear in P8-M; neither calendar name will change today.
options.zh: 修正後的資料列將寫入 P8-M；今天兩份行事曆的名稱都不變。
options.why: P8-M remains the only registered destination; without confirmation, names stay unchanged.
options.whyZh: P8-M 仍是唯一登記的目的地；未確認變更前，兩份行事曆的名稱不變。

options.text: No calendar will receive an export tonight.
options.zh: 今晚不會匯出到任何行事曆。
options.why: Not changing the destination does not stop the export.
options.whyZh: 未變更目的地並不會停止匯出。

options.text: P8-R will receive the corrected rows because it is the intended working calendar.
options.zh: P8-R 將收到已修正的資料列，因為它預定成為正式行事曆。
options.why: Intent does not change the registered destination.
options.whyZh: 預定使用哪一份和實際登記的目的地不同。

explanationZh: P8-M 仍是唯一登記的目的地；未確認變更前，兩份行事曆的名稱不變。
